m.aarti.pad1: Victory, victory to you, Kālarātri, Mahākālī, you who save from the jaws of death. Your name is Destroyer of the wicked; Mahācaṇḍī is your incarnation.
m.aarti.pad2: All that is spread over the earth and the sky, Mahākālī, is your expanse. You hold the sword and the skull-bowl; you taste the blood of the wicked.
m.aarti.pad3: Calcutta is your seat; everywhere I see the sight of you. All the gods, all men and women, sing all your praises.
m.aarti.pad4: If she who is Raktadantā and Annapūrṇā shows grace, no sorrow at all remains: no worry, no illness, no grief, no heavy trouble.
m.aarti.pad5: No suffering ever comes upon the one whom Mother Mahākālī saves. You too, devotee, say with love: Mother Kālarātri, victory to you.
